svg.title: FAFT versus zoom-sampled transforms of one fitted circle curve
svg.desc: Magnitude in dB versus frequency to three times the source Nyquist. Zoom 1 mirrors the audio band above 22.05 kHz; zoom 4 follows the exact FAFT; FAFT has no images.
svg.text: Same fitted curve, three transforms · 60 s window, Hann after fitting
Frequency (kHz); 0–22.05 kHz is the recorded band
